text.aria-label: Title text 'Quantile score of the day-ahead forecast of six metered solar farms (A to F), mean over farms, 12 to 36 h leads, daylight half-hours, 2025-09 to 2026-08. Own history: fitted on the farm's own earlier months. Zero history: fitted on the other five farms. P1 has no zero-history row. Dot: estimate (mean over five seeds for H5 and XGBoost). Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months.'
text.tspan: Quantile score of the day-ahead forecast of six metered solar farms (A to F), mean over farms,
12 to 36 h leads, daylight half-hours, 2025-09 to 2026-08. Own history: fitted on the farm's own earlier
months. Zero history: fitted on the other five farms. P1 has no zero-history row. Dot: estimate
(mean over five seeds for H5 and XGBoost). Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months.
